pairs.subject: generated-output-grading
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/clips.rs:473 The only visual output this crate types is a clip render. It is either trimmed from the show's own recording or re-drawn by the deterministic stage, so no generative image model, vision grader or generator comparison exists here for the subject to govern; I searched the crate for image, png, diffusion, vision_model and text_to_image and got zero hits.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/clips.rs:96 The veto-tier idea is present, but it gates a deterministic clip render (privacy, disclosure, citation), not a generated image.
crates/shadowrunr-types/src/results.rs:86 The only machine judge typed here grades simulated text transcripts. There is no vision grader.
crates/shadowrunr-types/src/results.rs:247 A text-transcript analog exists (a resume re-judges runs whose judge call failed), but no rendered images are graded.
crates/shadowrunr-types/src/results.rs:17 The matrix crosses tone, core tier, segment and audience size for LLM show simulations. It has no image-generator or style candidates.

pairs.registryProposal: The sim tournament types (results.rs) apply several of this subject's laws to LLM-generated text: hard-rule vetoes, unmeasured is not pass, cost per usable stream, judge-mismatch cells reported beside the ranking rather than in it, and re-judging without re-simulating on resume. These laws are not specific to images. They could be shared with llm-agent/eval-harness rather than living only under visual-generation.
